test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All threads are pins.

2. Some pins are cushions.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cushions are pins.

II. Some pins are threads.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9ff2f8c0a9a2aed133b55c78f591d2e277221c248dbfef594b6e3e7a642da10.png] 

Conclusions:
I. Some cushions are pins. → **Follows** (As, Some pins are cushions)
II. Some pins are threads. → Follows (As, All threads are pins)

Hence, **Both conclusions I and II follow**.
